contract.territory: Mets Home Television Territory (State of New York, State of Connecticut, State of New Jersey except certain counties, and specified counties in Pennsylvania, per Exhibit B)

deliverables.description: Right to advertise AlphaTrade's online investment management services during Mets home games on two permanent 4' by 38' signs on the press level facade at Shea Stadium, one in right field and one in left field, next to the Pitch Speed LED Scoreboards.
deliverables.frequency: each Mets home game, each season
sponsor_obligations: Responsible for the cost of fabrication of its signage
deliverables.source_quote:
The right to advertise AlphaTrade’s online investment management services during Mets home games on two
permanent 4’ by 38’ signs on the press level facade at Shea Stadium (the “Stadium”), one located in right field, and the
other located in left field, next to the two auxiliary matrix LED scoreboards (the “Pitch Speed LED Scoreboards”) that
indicate speed of pitch. AlphaTrade shall be responsible for the cost of fabrication of its signage.

deliverables.description: Right to display customized AlphaTrade-provided messages promoting its online investment management services, scrolling on the Pitch Speed LED Scoreboards during inning breaks of Mets regular home games.
deliverables.frequency: during inning breaks, each Mets regular home game
deliverables.source_quote:
The right to display customized messages, provided by AlphaTrade, promoting AlphaTrade’s online investment management services, which will scroll on the Pitch Speed LED Scoreboards during inning breaks during Mets regular
home games.

deliverables.description: One 15-second PA announcement per home game promoting either AlphaTrade's services or its sponsorship of an in-stadium text messaging contest (TMC), made on or before the bottom of the fifth inning, with AlphaTrade's logo displayed on the Stadium scoreboard during the announcement. TMC winners receive two Mets home game tickets provided by Sterling or a mutually agreed prize; AlphaTrade may award an additional mutually agreed grand prize and will be announced as its provider.
conditions: TMC subject to prior approval of MLBAM
TMC announcement made on or before the bottom of the fifth inning
Prize (if not tickets) mutually agreed by AlphaTrade and Sterling in advance of the TMC
Grand prize to be mutually agreed by the parties
deliverables.source_quote:
One 15-second announcement on the Stadium public address system during each Mets home game, promoting
either AlphaTrade’s online investment management services or AlphaTrade’s sponsorship of an in-stadium text messaging
contest (“TMC”), which TMC shall be subject to the prior approval of Major League Baseball Advanced Media
(“MLBAM”). The TMC announcement shall be made on or before the bottom of the fifth (5th) inning. AlphaTrade’s logo
will be prominently displayed on the Stadium scoreboard during any such announcement. TMC winners will receive either
(i) two tickets to a 2007 or 2008 Mets home game, provided by Sterling, or (ii) a prize to be mutually agreed to by
AlphaTrade and Sterling in advance of the TMC. AlphaTrade will have the option to award an additional grand prize, to be
mutually agreed to by the parties. AlphaTrade will be announced as the provider of any such grand prize.

deliverables.description: Advertising inventory valued at $50,000 per season (based on applicable rate card) during Mets and/or other programming on SportsNet New York.
conditions: Value based on the applicable rate card
Details to be mutually agreed between the parties
deliverables.source_quote:
Advertising inventory with a value of $50,000, based on the applicable rate card, each season during the Term,
during Mets and/or other programming on SportsNet New York, with details to be mutually agreed to between the parties.

deliverables.description: Sponsorship of a mutually agreed sweepstakes or TMC on mets.com, promoted in rotating banner ads posted by MLBAM for the duration of the Sweepstakes (approx. 6 to 8 weeks) and in one promotional email distributed by MLBAM. Sterling provides the prize(s); official rules provided by MLBAM or Sterling.
conditions: Subject to terms and conditions in Exhibit A
Sweepstakes, banner advertisements and promotional email subject to prior approval of MLBAM
Official rules subject to reasonable approval of AlphaTrade
Sweepstakes prize(s) mutually agreed between the parties
sponsor_obligations: Per Exhibit A, solely responsible and liable for all aspects of the Sweepstakes including administration, fulfillment and legal compliance
deliverables.source_quote:
Sponsorship by AlphaTrade of a mutually agreed upon sweepstakes or TMC (collectively referred to herein as
the “Sweepstakes”) to be featured on the official New York Mets website (www.mets.com) (the “Website”), subject to the
terms and conditions set forth in Exhibit A hereto. The Sweepstakes and AlphaTrade’s sponsorship thereof shall be
promoted in rotating banner advertisements on the Website that will be posted by MLBAM for the duration of the
Sweepstakes (approximately 6 to 8 weeks) (the “Sweepstakes Period”), and in one promotional email distributed by
MLBAM during the Sweepstakes Period. The Sweepstakes, banner advertisements and promotional email are subject to
the prior approval of MLBAM. The official rules of the Sweepstakes shall be provided by MLBAM or Sterling, subject to
the reasonable approval of AlphaTrade. The Sweepstakes prize(s) will be provided by Sterling and mutually agreed to
between the parties.

deliverables.description: Four field level tickets to each Mets regular season home game at the Stadium, plus the right to purchase the same seats for any Mets post season games at the Stadium, limited to the Term and not subject to renewal.
deliverables.frequency: each Mets regular season home game
conditions: Post season seats available for purchase only
Rights limited to the Term and not subject to renewal
sponsor_obligations: Purchase post season tickets if desired
deliverables.source_quote:
Four field level tickets to each Mets regular season home game at the Stadium (and the right to purchase the
same seats for any Mets post season games at the Stadium) during the Term. Such rights shall be limited to the Term
hereof, and are not subject to renewal.

deliverables.description: Use of one 15-person Diamond View Suite, including food and beverages for 15 guests, on two mutually agreed Mets regular season home game dates.
deliverables.frequency: per season, on mutually agreed dates
conditions: Dates mutually agreed
sponsor_obligations: Comply with all usage rules issued by Sterling applicable to suite holders
deliverables.source_quote:
Use of one 15-person Diamond View Suite, including food and beverages for 15 guests, on two mutually agreed
upon Mets regular season home game dates. AlphaTrade shall be responsible for compliance with all usage rules issued by
Sterling applicable to suite holders.

deliverables.description: Right to advertise AlphaTrade's services in one full page, four-color print advertisement in the annual New York Mets Yearbook.
deliverables.source_quote:
The right to advertise AlphaTrade’s online investment management services in one full page, four-color, print
advertisement in the annual New York Mets Yearbook.

deliverables.description: Opportunity to use the field at KeySpan Park for a softball game on one mutually agreed date, with up to 40 participants and as many spectators in the seating bowl as BBC allows for similar events.
conditions: Date mutually agreed
Up to 40 participants
Spectators limited to as many as BBC allows for similar events
Releases of liability in form acceptable to Sterling in its sole discretion
sponsor_obligations: Secure releases of liability in favor of Sterling and Brooklyn Baseball Company, L.L.C. from each individual permitted to enter the field
deliverables.source_quote:
Opportunity to use the field at KeySpan Park to play a softball game on one mutually agreed upon date.
AlphaTrade shall secure releases of liability in favor of Sterling and Brooklyn Baseball Company, L.L.C., in a form
acceptable to Sterling in its sole discretion, from each individual who will be permitted to enter the field at KeySpan Park
for this event. AlphaTrade will have the right to have up to forty (40) people to participate in the softball game and as
many spectators in the seating bowl at KeySpan Park as BBC allows for similar events.

deliverables.description: Four tickets to each of five Mets Spring Training home games at Tradition Field, Florida.
deliverables.frequency: each of five Spring Training home games
deliverables.source_quote: Four tickets to each of five Mets Spring Training home games at Tradition Field, Florida.

deliverables.description: Right to use the designation "Official Sponsor of the New York Mets" to promote AlphaTrade's services, non-exclusive use of the Mets name, limited to the Term and the Mets Home Television Territory.
conditions: Limited to the Term and the Mets Home Television Territory, as may be amended
Use of Mets name is non-exclusive and subject to MLB Entities' rules, regulations, agreements or guidelines
All materials containing the Mets name require Sterling's prior written approval, in its reasonable discretion
No rights in Sterling's trademarks except as expressly granted
sponsor_obligations: Indemnify, hold harmless and defend Sterling against claims arising out of use of the Mets name
deliverables.source_quote:
The right for AlphaTrade to use the designation “Official Sponsor of the New York Mets” to promote
AlphaTrade’s online investment management services, subject to the conditions set forth below.

deliverables.description: Joint public announcement by both parties within three days of execution of the official sponsor agreement, further announcements as agreed, and the right for AlphaTrade to use a boilerplate official sponsor statement (Exhibit C) in its public news announcements distributed only within the Mets Home Television Territory.
conditions: Further announcements as agreed by AlphaTrade and the Mets
Any Sterling approvals not unreasonably delayed or withheld
Boilerplate statement in form of Exhibit C
Boilerplate distributed only within the Mets Home Television Territory
deliverables.source_quote:
Within three days of the execution of the Agreement, a public announcement will be made by both parties as to
the completion of a binding agreement that gives AlphaTrade official sponsor status with the Mets. Further announcements
will be made as agreed to by AlphaTrade and the Mets. If any approvals are required for AlphaTrade from Sterling for the
public announcements, such approval shall not be unreasonably delayed or withheld. AlphaTrade will be able to create and
utilize a boilerplate statement about its official sponsor status on its public new announcements, distributed only within the
Mets Home Television Territory, in the form attached hereto as Exhibit C.
